name: dev.quarterslot/quarterslot
title: Quarterslot
description: Agent tools paid per call in USDC (x402): webhook inbox, DOCX/PPTX/PDF, AI visibility check.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a webhook inbox ($0.002). Returns a public callback_url to hand to any async API (rendering, transcription, crawls, task queues) and a token for read_inbox. Keeps up to 100 messages of ≤256 KB for up to 7 days.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read deliveries to an inbox (free). Pass next_after from the previous call as `after`; wait_seconds (≤20) long-polls for new messages.

after.description: Return only messages after this sequence number (next_after from the last call)

wait_seconds.description: Long-poll up to this many seconds for a new message

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete an inbox and its messages now (free).

tools.name: convert_to_docx
tools.description: Convert Markdown or HTML to a Word document with real heading styles, lists, tables, code blocks and links. ($0.002) Returns the file as an embedded resource (base64).

html.description: HTML fragment or full document (send this or markdown)

title.description: Document title; also used for the file name

tools.name: convert_to_pptx
tools.description: Convert Markdown or HTML to a 16:9 PowerPoint deck. Slides split at --- lines or at # / ## headings; up to 100 slides. ($0.002) Returns the file as an embedded resource (base64).

html.description: HTML fragment or full document (send this or markdown)

title.description: Document title; also used for the file name

tools.name: convert_to_pdf
tools.description: Render Markdown or HTML to a print-ready PDF (Letter or A4). JavaScript off, no network: use inline data: images. ($0.004) Returns the file as an embedded resource (base64).

html.description: HTML fragment or full document (send this or markdown)

title.description: Document title; also used for the file name

tools.name: audit_tags
tools.description: Load a public page in a real browser, then accept and reject its consent banner, and report which analytics/ad tags fire at each step (GA4, GTM, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads and more), Consent Mode v2 signals, duplicates, Meta event_id and gclid/fbclid storage, with findings and a 0-100 score ($0.10).

test_click_ids.description: Append test gclid/fbclid and check they are stored (default true)

tools.name: audit_landing_page
tools.description: Render a public page at iPhone size and score ad-to-page message match, first screen, form friction, trust and mobile usability; returns measured page facts, scores and the top fixes ($0.15).

ad_headline.description: Headline of the ad that sends traffic here (enables message-match scoring)

include_screenshot.description: Also return the first-screen screenshot as base64 JPEG (default false)

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Ask one prompt to ChatGPT (GPT-5.4 mini), Gemini and Claude, each with live web search, and report whether a brand is mentioned, its rank against named competitors, and whether its domain is cited ($0.20). Not charged if fewer than two engines answer.

brand.description: Brand name to look for in the answers

prompt.description: The question a buyer would ask an AI assistant

aliases.description: Other names the brand goes by

competitors.description: Competitor names to rank the brand against
